title: Establishing Islamic Adab and Moral Conscience (Ages 4-6)
description: A tarbiyah journey to establish foundational Islamic akhlaq values (truthfulness, amanah, rahmah, respect) during the preoperational stage (Piaget). Focuses on transforming concepts from theoretical knowledge into heart-based behavioral habits through compassionate parental modeling, Prophetic stories, and daily dialogue. Avoids coercive methods, and relies on the Prophetic principle of gradualism and qudwah (exemplary conduct) as a tool for moral development in this sensitive stage.

primary_reference.info: Ibn Qayyim al-Jawziyyah, Tuhfat al-Mawdud bi-Ahkam al-Mawlud, chapter on disciplining children and refining their character
